title: plugin-auth: register the app:seeded backfill handler from the arming kernel:ready handler, so the guard #22312 added is structural and check:settings-bind-window can see it (child of #22316)
body:
This card carries the `plugin-auth` half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22316: one structural move in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-plugin.ts`. The parent keeps the gate half, PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22325 (`scripts/check-settings-bind-window.mjs`), which lands after this one.

Filing gate: an in-flight derivative sub-issue of objectstack-ai/objectstack#22316 (`domain:devx`, `priority:p3` inherited), filed and owned by the claiming seat (`domain:devx` seat 1, #6023, `session_0115N1oNnQS5WqofZ2DzaT3q`). Reader: that seat, which dispatches it directly.

## Why

- PR #22325 widens the gate to every Phase-1/2 hook and follows promise continuations. Measured by its developer (`os-dev-report` on #22316): on `main` with PR objectstack-ai/objectstack#22312 merged, the gate reads RED at `auth-plugin.ts` `[app:seeded-hook-from-start]`.
- The cause: PR #22312 made the early `app:seeded` backfill calls no-ops through a runtime flag. At `origin/main` `28bff18d0c`, `let backfillArmed = false` (`:1295`) is set inside the `kernel:ready` handler (`:1353`). But `ctx.hook('app:seeded', () => runBackfill('app:seeded'))` (`:1364`) is registered unconditionally from `start()`. A static walk cannot see a runtime flag.
- Measured by the same developer in a throwaway worktree on the merged tree: registering the `app:seeded` handler from inside the arming `kernel:ready` handler makes the widened gate read GREEN, with no ledger entry.

## Done when

- The `app:seeded` handler is registered from inside the arming `kernel:ready` handler, so it cannot run before the bind by construction.
- Runtime behaviour is unchanged. Every pin PR #22312 added passes unchanged (`auth-settings-ordering.pin.test.ts`, `auth-settings-seeded-boot.pin.test.ts`), along with the package's suite. The developer judges whether `backfillArmed` is still needed and removes it only if it is provably dead.
- PR #22325's widened `check:settings-bind-window` reads GREEN on a tree carrying this change.
- One patch changeset for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`. ⛔ No behaviour, option or public-surface change.

The decision behind this split is recorded on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22316.
